author: Afro-Latino Education & Arts Collective
title: Seeking Black Puerto Rican Female Illustrator for Commission
content:
Tag a Black Puerto Rican female illustrator. 🇵🇷🎨

PLEASE READ BEFORE SUBMITTING: As the Afro-Latino Education & Arts Collective, part of our mission is creating intentional opportunities for Black-identifying Latino artists and creatives. This particular commission is specifically seeking a Black-identifying Puerto Rican female illustrator.

Puerto Rican heritage alone does not meet the criteria for this particular commission. Having African ancestry or Black relatives is also not the same as personally identifying as Black.

We ask that applicants please respect the specificity of this opportunity so that space intentionally created for Black Puerto Rican female artists remains available to Black Puerto Rican female artists.

Thank you for respecting the intention of the commission.

Contact: Tag artists in comments or DM the account.

author: Rano Chidiya Cartoon / tunistorytv
title: Hiring 2D Animators
content:

Join us and help bring amazing cartoon stories to life! 🌳🐦✨
